The rest, in order

From these references to the journey.

01 · Set the references

Select the character designs and prepare only the clean individual views and gameplay poses the project needs.

02 · Prove one video

Choose a model and a cost/attempt limit first. Generate the basket-recognition shot; judge identity, motion, wordless meaning and actual cost.

03 · Produce & connect

Produce the remaining videos by location. Implementation agents finish destinations, journey saves, story progression and playback.
